context: Mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 従兄弟/見分け/嫌っ/よくなる/こらえ/探さ/さして/ペンキ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、従兄弟、絶対、のお兄ちゃん、絶対、お家に来てくれるわよ
lines.en: Sho, your cousin-brother is definitely coming over to the house, you know.
lines.style: Bright, assured tone. Warm certainty—the kind of promise a mother makes to reassure. Open, slightly sing-song cadence. Energetic but grounded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、見分け、絶対、できるよ、本物と偽物
lines.en: Mom, I can definitely tell the difference between the real one and the fake one.
lines.style: Small voice with real conviction underneath. Quiet pride—not boasting, just stating a fact he knows. Slight lift at the end, seeking her belief in him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、本気で、絶対、嫌っ、絶対、てた、絶対、ピーマン、絶対、最近食べてるわ
lines.en: Sho, you know your dad has actually started eating green peppers lately—the ones he used to hate.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly wondering. Soft, almost to herself. A small smile in the voice—noticing change without making a big deal of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、お加減、絶対、よくなる、絶対、よね?本気で
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa is going to get better soon, right?
lines.style: Small, careful voice. Worry underneath—not panic, but real concern. Seeking confirmation more than asking. Slight hesitation before the question mark.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、テスト悪くても、本気で、絶対、こらえ、絶対、て、絶対、頑張ろうね
lines.en: Sho, even if your test didn't go well, let's both do our best and keep going, okay?
lines.style: Steady, encouraging tone. A gentle reminder, not a lecture. Practical warmth—acknowledging difficulty without dwelling on it. The 'both of us' implied in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、お友達、絶対、探さ、絶対、なきゃ
lines.en: Mom, I really need to find a friend.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact statement. Serious underneath—this is something he's been thinking about. Not desperate, but clear-eyed about what he needs. Small and grounded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、本気で、絶対、さして、絶対、お疲れではないみたいよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad doesn't seem especially tired at the moment.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly reassuring. Observant tone—she's noticed something and is reporting it gently. Warm but understated. A small, knowing quality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、本気で、絶対、ペンキ、絶対、塗ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad was painting the whole time.
lines.style: Bright clarification, almost pleased to report what he saw. Matter-of-fact observation from a small, noticing voice. Quick and clean—the statement of something obvious once you look.
